CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real Phase 1a shipped: server-authoritative fragment physics, the smallest first slice from NORTHSTAR.md's own DoD -- a small bounded set of just-detached fragments fall under real gravity and land at the real ground height server-side, broadcast over a deliberately minimal wire shape (only y, not full x/y/z); verified live end-to-end via a real UDP probe reading the new packet fields directly, watching real y decrease under gravity then land; client rendering deferred as Phase 1b (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
